class.name: OcgGraphic3dAttribbuffer
class.brief_description: Buffer of vertex attributes. This class is intended for advanced usage allowing invalidation of entire buffer content or its sub-part.
class.description: ! Buffer of vertex attributes. ! This class is intended for advanced usage allowing invalidation of entire buffer content or its ! sub-part.

method.name: SetMutable
method.description: Set if data can be invalidated.

method.name: SetInterleaved
method.description: Setup interleaved/non-interleaved array. WARNING! Filling non-interleaved buffer should be implemented on user side without Graphic3d_Buffer auxiliary methods designed for interleaved data.

method.name: Invalidate_4
method.description: Invalidate attribute data within specified sub-range (starting from 0).

method.name: Invalidate_3
method.description: Invalidate all attribute data within specified vertex sub-range (starting from 0).

method.name: invalidate
method.description: Invalidate specified sub-range of data (as byte offsets).
